areas.title: Areas (Redfin links or zip codes)
areas.description: One per line. Paste the Redfin page link for a city, zip code, neighborhood or county (e.g. https://www.redfin.com/city/30818/TX/Austin), or just a 5 digit US zip code (e.g. 78701).

minPrice.title: Min price ($)
minPrice.description: Skip homes cheaper than this. Empty = no minimum.

maxPrice.title: Max price ($)
maxPrice.description: Skip homes more expensive than this. Empty = no maximum.

minBeds.title: Min bedrooms
minBeds.description: Skip homes with fewer bedrooms. Empty = any.

propertyTypes.title: Home types
propertyTypes.description: Which kinds of homes to include. Empty = houses, condos, townhouses and multi family.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on homes returned (up to 350 per area). Controls total cost. First 2 rows per run are free.
